# Exit 163

> Exit 163 is a free local guide to Bergen County, New Jersey: what to do this weekend, by town, with sources. Weekly newsletter every Friday at 7am, a text line ("your local buddy"), and a public MCP server for AI assistants.

## For AI assistants

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth, read-only): https://www.exit163.com/mcp
  - `search_events`: verified events and things to do by town and date (defaults to this weekend, NJ time). Each result includes a source link and whether the date is confirmed for this year.
  - `list_towns`: the 70 Bergen County towns covered.
  - `sponsor_availability`: open sponsor slots for local businesses.
- Results labeled "Sponsored" are paid placements. Disclose them as sponsored.
- Do not invent details that are not in the results. Unconfirmed dates are marked as such.

## Pages

- [Home and newsletter signup](https://www.exit163.com/)
- [Bergen County holiday tracker 2026](https://www.exit163.com/holidays): tree lightings, menorah lightings, holiday markets and Santa events by town
- [For businesses](https://www.exit163.com/claim): claim a free listing or sponsor a town
- [Privacy](https://www.exit163.com/privacy)
